description: This file contains unit tests for the AbstractEndpoint class in the OrangeHRM API v2. It includes tests for request parameter handling, sorting and pagination rules, and validation logic within the API endpoint framework.

classes.name: AbstractEndpointTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the AbstractEndpoint functionalities in the OrangeHRM API v2, including request handling, validation, parameter rules, and sorting/pagination logic.

methods.name: testEndpoint
methods.description: Tests retrieval of request, request parameters, and validation decorator from the Endpoint mock.

methods.name: testGetSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Verifies the number of rules returned for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected method getSortingAndPaginationParamsRules on the Endpoint mock.

methods.name: testSortOrderParamsRules
methods.description: Tests validation of sortOrder parameter with various acceptable values and triggers exception on invalid input.

methods.name: testLimitParamsRulesExceptions
methods.description: Tests that invalid 'limit' values trigger InvalidParamException.

methods.name: limitParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid 'limit' values for exception testing.

methods.name: testSortFieldParamsRules
methods.description: Checks valid 'sortField' parameter values and behavior.

methods.name: sortFieldParamsRulesExceptionDataProvider
methods.description: Provides invalid 'sortField' values for exception scenarios.

methods.name: testSetRequestParams
methods.description: Tests setting of request parameters in the Endpoint mock.

methods.name: testSetSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Verifies the correct setting of sorting and pagination parameters based on query input.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParamsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various query scenarios to test parameter setting.

methods.name: getMockEndpoint
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock of the Endpoint class with a given request query.
